## Active

### D-168 — Timer assertions carry slack because Node fires timers early

> _2026-09-15 · core/blong-chain · active_

A step that awaits `setTimeout(resolve, 50)` completes in 49.x ms about once in 60 runs, because
Node's timers can fire marginally before their nominal delay: measured over 400 iterations,
`duration` was 49 in seven of them. Asserting `duration >= 50` was therefore a real flake rather
than a slow machine. The assertions in `core/blong-chain`'s tests now subtract `TIMER_SLACK_MS` of 5
ms from the nominal delay and print the observed value.
